item.title: 10k-Mile 2003 Dodge Viper SRT-10 Roadster at No Reserve
item.description: This 2003 Dodge Viper SRT-10 roadster has 10k miles following history in Florida, Georgia, and New Hampshire and is finished in Viper Red over black leather and microsuede. The car is powered by an 8.3-liter V10 paired with a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 1971 Volvo 1800E at No Reserve
item.description: This 1971 Volvo 1800E is said to have remained under the care of its original owner in Arizona until 2008, and it shows 104k miles. The car is finished in Gold Metallic over tan leather and is powered by a 2.0-liter inline-four mated to a three-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes Bosch D-Jetronic fuel injection, 15" Clover wheels, chrome trim, four-wheel disc brakes, front bucket seats, an aftermarket CD stereo, air conditioning, and a heater. item.title: 1991 Jeep Grand Wagoneer Final Edition
item.description: This 1991 Jeep Grand Wagoneer was built in June 1991 as one of the last SJ-chassis Grand Wagoneers made during the nameplate's final model year. The truck is said to be one of less than 40 that were finished from the factory in Spinnaker Blue. The vehicle spent time in Arkansas, Oklahoma, and Texas under prior ownership, and the seller bought it in 2024 after the Jeep reportedly had been sitting in a New Mexico barn for nearly 20 years. item.title: 2012 Rossion Q1

item.title: 1988.5 Ferrari 328 GTS
item.description: This 1988.5 Ferrari 328 is one of approximately 6,068 removable-top GTS examples produced, and its odometer currently shows 12k miles. item.title: Custom 1955 Ford Thunderbird “Moon Rocket” 3-Speed
item.description: This 1955 Ford Thunderbird was purchased new by San Francisco-based hot rod builder Jerry Anolik and modified prior to winning the People's Choice Award at the Oakland Roadster Show in January 1957. Custom front bodywork was constructed following a crash, and the car was reintroduced at the 1959 Oakland Roadster Show where it was dubbed "Moon Rocket" by fellow builder George Barris. item.title: 1979 Porsche 930 Turbo
item.description: This 1979 Porsche 930 Turbo is finished in Black Metallic over black leather upholstery and powered by a turbocharged 3.3-liter flat-six paired with a four-speed manual transaxle. Equipment includes front and rear spoilers, fog lights, 16″ Fuchs wheels, and an aftermarket stereo system. It was previously sold on BaT in March 2023 and was acquired by the current owner in 2024. item.title: Bugatti Type 35B Re-Creation by Pur Sang
item.description: This Bugatti Type 35B re-creation was hand built by Pur Sang in Argentina in late 2022 before final assembly was carried out in California. Purchased by the selling dealer approximately three years ago, the car is powered by a supercharged 2.3-liter inline-eight that features a single overhead camshaft, three valves per cylinder, and a single updraft carburetor. item.title: 1987 Lamborghini Countach 5000 QV
item.description: This 1987 Lamborghini Countach is one of approximately 610 examples of the 5000 Quattrovalvole variant produced between 1985 and 1988. Chassis 12108 was acquired by the current owner in 2016 and underwent an engine-out service, an interior refresh, and dry-ice cleaning of the underside in 2025. Now showing 10k kilometers (~6k miles), the car is finished in Bianco Perlato over Rosso leather and rides on body-color 15″ Ruote OZ wheels.
